title: Beyond Reference-Based Evaluation: Reward Models for Meta-Evaluation of Grammatical Error Correction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reference-based metrics for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) such as M$^2$ and ERRANT assume that the reference set enumerates all valid edits, and therefore often penalize corrections that are grammatical and meaning-preserving but phrased differently. We introduce RM-EVAL, a reward model trained on human preference data from SEEDA, as a reference-free meta-evaluator that predicts human-like quality judgments at both full-sequence and partial-sequence levels. Beyond evaluation, we show that the same reward model can be used as a learning signal to improve GEC generation via Reward-Guided Text Generation (RGTG), which keeps a base GEC model frozen and performs online, reward-driven decoding. Across SEEDA, RM-EVAL achieves strong agreement with human rankings, and RGTG yields consistent gains in reward and external validation, demonstrating a unified framework for both assessing and enhancing GEC systems without relying on gold referenc

translated_title: 超越基于参考答案的评估：用于语法纠错元评估的奖励模型
translated_abstract: 诸如 M² 和 ERRANT 等基于参考答案的语法纠错（GEC）评估指标假设参考集合枚举了所有有效的修改，因此常常会错误地惩罚那些语法正确、保持原意但表述方式不同的纠正结果。我们提出了 RM-EVAL，一个基于 SEEDA 人类偏好数据训练的奖励模型，作为无需参考答案的元评估器，能够在完整序列和部分序列两个层面上预测类似人类的评分判断。除了评估之外，我们还展示了同一个奖励模型可以作为学习信号，通过奖励引导文本生成（RGTG）来改进 GEC 生成，该方法保持基础 GEC 模型冻结不变，并执行在线的、奖励驱动的解码。在 SEEDA 上，RM-EVAL 与人类排名达成了高度一致，而 RGTG 在奖励和外部验证方面均带来了一致的提升，展示了一个无需依赖黄金参考答案即可同时评估和增强 GEC 系统的统一框架。
tldr: 提出了基于人类偏好数据训练的奖励模型 RM-EVAL，作为无需参考答案的 GEC 元评估器，并可通过奖励引导文本生成（RGTG）在同一框架下既评估又提升语法纠错系统的性能。
en_tdlr: We introduce RM-EVAL, a reward model trained on human preferences that serves as a reference-free meta-evaluator for GEC, and show the same model can enhance GEC generation via reward-guided decoding, forming a unified framework for both assessing and improving GEC systems without gold references.
